name: Quas Killam
description: Quas Killam was a planet on the edge of the Mid Rim. Its people were the Killam. Quas Killam was a world of weapons manufacturing factories and trinium mines, and so was conquered by the Trade Federation early in the Clone Wars. Throughout the war the planet changed sides several times.
